checks.message: Boundary is explicitly a provisional constraint, not a statutory redline or precise-area basis; full recalculation is recorded for trusted official geometry.
Three key areas retain organizer-supplied provisional geometry; no station, road, parcel, ownership, or approved-development inference is made.
Functional polygons are recalculated in EPSG:4548, share topology from one provisional site constraint, form one gap-free/non-overlapping temporary partition, and exchange as EPSG:4326.
共同 RACI 与普通服务连续性规则在场景卡总则定义一次；S01–S12 分别保留独特的责任、进入、拒收/退回、停止、恢复、证据与复核，联合通行证/H1-H3 在 proposal 和 Figure 01/05 可读。
FAR, height, statutory density/green ratio, setbacks, utilities, energy/cooling, heat recovery, investment and schedule remain unknown without project evidence.
No site visit, measurement, simulation, deployment, vendor test, user test or human review is claimed; protocols are proposed and untested.
Chinese primary proposal and complete English counterpart share chapters, four-contract logic, scenarios, geometry status, unknowns and evidence anchors.

HTML is static/offline. v1.3 figures use local SVG/PNG technical overlays and a disclosed local non-geographic image-generation base at no more than 4.5% opacity; no remote asset/map/CDN/script/tracker/form/font is loaded.

Twelve small conceptual reference modules replace the former megablocks. Public, controlled, maintenance/exit, and emergency/ordinary-recovery path relations are separately identified; they remain non-surveyed, non-statutory concepts.
The joint four-contract passport defines minimum evidence, receiving/refusal, pause, restoration acceptance, proposed RACI, procurement replacement conditions, and ordinary-service continuity.

Local pypdf inspection on 2026-08-10 confirmed: both A3 editions have 12 readable-text pages at 420×297 mm landscape; both A0 editions have 4 readable-text boards at 1189×841 mm landscape. Page order and Chinese/English counterpart counts align.
五组中英文技术图保留本地 SVG 源与 PNG 衍生，临时边界低对比虚线；中性四端口符号、组合、单色/高对比/低墨量和实体应用集中于 Figure 05 与 A3/A0。

MOHURD-ARCH-DESIGN-DEPTH-2016 is correctly recorded as mandatory=false and review_status=data_gap, with only its repository-defined missing-official-file record cited. No urban-design standard is substituted as its source.
